### Exp-4 clamp ablation: the potential field with and without the separation clamp

50 seeds x 3 formations per condition, 60 s at 50 Hz (3000 ticks per trial), seed = trial index x 42, kinematic backend. Collision distance 0.35 m; clamp distance 0.80 m. Separated spawn: the protocol N(0, 0.5 m) spawn redrawn from the same seeded generator until no pair starts closer than 0.80 m.

Medians are per trial with order-statistic 95% intervals; collision trials are counts with exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% intervals. With the clamp on, distances and ticks are measured after the clamp, as Exp-4 reports them.
